Game Overview

In Market Cargo Simulator, the core idea is straightforward: navigate bustling cityscapes as a truck driver delivering cargo. Test your precision and timing while maneuvering through tight corners, narrow streets, and amidst unpredictable traffic. Experience the art of careful driving, aiming for smooth and efficient deliveries in this immersive 3D driving simulator.
